scientific_integrity: Originality is bounded to the three-subgroup regular operator spectrum and rank census; pairwise MUB overlap, finite-group Fourier decomposition, and quadratic Gauss evaluations are pre-existing methods. Numerical checks are finite corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes; three pairwise distinct noncentral projected directions; normalized positive subgroup averages. A general prior stabilizer-state Gram theorem could subsume some consequences; not independently validated.
title: Three-line Heisenberg tomography: a complete Gauss-phase spectrum and a characteristic-three rank jump
